description:
Capture: images of the running game for visual checks. Each tool attaches one JPEG or PNG image to its result.
Workflow: screenshot to see exactly what the player sees (UI optional); scene_capture to look from any camera pose
(e.g. above or behind something you built) without moving the player; capture_render_target to read a render target.
name: capture

tools.description:
Reads a render target, or a scene capture's render target, as an image. Fails if the target is neither, or the render target cannot be read.
Returns: Image size {w, h, source_w, source_h}; the image is attached.

max_dim.description: Longest side of the returned image in px, 64-4096.

target.description: Render target object path, or a SceneCapture2D actor / component. (Reference to Object: node id (n12), node path, actor:Name or object path)

tools.name: capture.capture_render_target

returnValue.description: Image size {w, h, source_w, source_h}; the image is attached.

h.description: Height of the attached image in px.

w.description: Width of the attached image in px.

returnValue.title: RuntimeImageInfo

tools.description:
Renders the scene from any camera pose (default: the player camera) without moving the player. Fails when rendering is disabled (null RHI).
Returns: Image size {w, h, source_w, source_h}; the image is attached.

fov.description: Horizontal field of view in degrees, 5-170.

location.description: Camera position [x, y, z] in cm. ([x, y, z] (cm))

look_at.description: Point to look at [x, y, z] (overrides rotation). ([x, y, z] (cm))

max_dim.description: Longest side of the returned image in px.

rotation.description: Camera rotation [pitch, yaw, roll] in degrees. ([pitch, yaw, roll] (degrees))

tools.name: capture.scene_capture

returnValue.description: Image size {w, h, source_w, source_h}; the image is attached.

h.description: Height of the attached image in px.

w.description: Width of the attached image in px.

returnValue.title: RuntimeImageInfo

tools.description:
Captures the game viewport as an image on the next rendered frame (async). Fails without a game viewport (null RHI, dedicated server): use scene_capture there.
Returns: Image size {w, h, source_w, source_h}; the image is attached.

max_dim.description: Longest side of the returned image in px, 64-4096 (capped by project settings).

tools.name: capture.screenshot

h.description: Height of the attached image in px.

w.description: Width of the attached image in px.
